law: GIFs are earned by recurrence (house VISUALS.md). Files here are canonical; lane copies are caches. First frame doubles as the still emblem.
style: blue-ink pencil-engraving on white, ~310x414, 12 frames, loop, 0.5-1.5MB, no text

entries.motif: dog at water with its reflection
entries.depicts: A puppy at a pond edge gazing at its own reflection in still water.
entries.means: The self meeting itself; the owner smuggled into the story. Play wherever recognition misfires.
entries.use: n02 leaning-mechanics, n09 dog chapter. Never as mere cuteness.

entries.depicts: A vintage projector beaming a landscape onto a screen in a dark room.
entries.means: Consciousness as projection; the show that needs no world behind it.
entries.use: n03 cinema trick. Pairs with magician, never same span.

entries.motif: donkey chasing carrot on a stick
entries.depicts: A donkey pulling a cart, chasing a carrot dangled ahead of it.
entries.means: Goalless pursuit; the goal recedes because the chase produces it.

entries.depicts: An antique sewing machine mid-stitch, thread running.
entries.means: Stitching a self together; the final stitch never made. Closing energy.
entries.use: n10 seamstress and finale. Nowhere else.

entries.depicts: Lotus leaf beaded with rain that will not stick.
A lit oil lamp, flame leaning in dark air.
entries.means: Attention itself; the flame that goes out is also the one that sees.
entries.use: n01 fire beats, n07 exhausted-lamp chapter (counterpoint: lit vs out).

entries.depicts: Open hands letting dry sand run through.
entries.means: Release; possession failing in real time.
entries.use: n08 sandcastle chapter. Hands, never fists.

entries.depicts: A stage magician presenting a levitation, audience watching.
entries.means: The trick of consciousness; total conviction, nothing behind it.
entries.use: n09 magic-show chapter. Never alongside cinema in one span.

entries.motif: raft on water, abandon after crossing
entries.depicts: A figure on a bamboo raft, hand trailing in the water.
entries.means: The vehicle to abandon after crossing; means, not home.
entries.use: n10 raft beats. Never as travel scenery.

entries.depicts: Engraved wave gathering itself toward calm water.
entries.means: Agitation resolving without going anywhere; the whirlpool ending.

entries.brief: A dying flame above cooling ash, last smoke thread rising straight. Blue-ink engraving, white ground. Why: the extinction thesis in one image (n01 opening, n07 lamp chapter).

entries.motif: figure leaning on a vanishing wall
entries.brief: A lone figure leaning on a wall that fades to white. Why: dependence mistaken for stability (n02).
Small oval hand mirror reflecting blank white. Why: the owner-inventing danger-object (n03/n04/n09).

entries.motif: jewel glinting in pond water, reached for
entries.brief: One jewel glinting just under pond ripples, half-seen. Why: existent-or-not, the two-lunatics object (n03/n04).
A stamped savings passbook, columns of merit-ink. Why: the merit-accounting joke engine (n06-n08).
A wood plane with fresh curled shavings. Why: self-critique made object (n10, n04 planks).
Seven chariots receding toward one horizon point. Why: many vehicles, one destination (n10). Distant, minimal.
A runner passing a small flame-baton onward. Why: the practice relay (n10). Motion: handoff loop.
Low dark treeline advancing at dusk, torches. Why: the death chapter mustering (n08). Keep distant, no gore.
An open hand closing on drifting smoke. Why: the most recurrent image lane-wide; appropriation failing.
One tangled knot with loose ends on white. Why: self-tie across n03-n09.

entries.motif: signpost with arms pointing every way

entries.brief: Clear quartz cluster, sharp and colorless. Why: verse 6 hinge, clarity that adds nothing (p01).

entries.motif: plain bowl of rice, steam rising
entries.brief: A plain full bowl of rice, steam curling. Why: enlightenment via rice, verse 18 (p02). Humble, no garnish.
Dewed web with spider at center, radial symmetry. Why: self-trapped Siva (p03).
Sunrise over still water, one horizontal gold band. Why: remembrance not travel (p04). Minimal.
An open door onto pure white. Why: the temple is everywhere (p05). No building.
An empty skull-bowl, single-line drawing. Why: cremation chapter (p06). Line only, reverent.
First light splitting night cloud over water. Why: recognition as daybreak (p07). Brighter sibling of sunrise-water.
A seated figure dissolving upward into rainbow light bands. Why: fruition image (d05). Joyful, not spooky.

entries.motif: scales weighing a feather against a heart
entries.brief: Balanced scales, feather on one pan, heart on other. Why: judgment beats (d02, madman, ancestors).
A shrouded figure sitting upright, minimal lines. Why: tukdam/mummy beats. Stillness, never horror.
